seatedToss.guidance: Garai patafura, muchishandurana kukanda bhegi rine nyoro mukati mechinangwa chikuru. Chengetai kuverenga papepa, pamwe chete.
steps: Dhindai chinangwa nepepa rekuverenga, muise zvakatsetseka patafura pakati penyu.
Garai zvakanaka, mumwe kune rumwe rutivi. Shandurai kukanda kamwe kamwe nyoro, kana mungada kusakanda.
Kukanda kunopinda mumhete, munhu akakanda anoisa chiratidzo pabhokisi rimwe mukholamu yake, pamutsara wemhete iyoyo.
Kana muchida, tarisai zviratidzo pamwe chete pamunomira. Hapana munhu anofanira kuwedzera nhamba.
Mirai nguva ipi neipi kana wenyu akagadzirira.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Shandisai bhegi rine chivharo chakabatirwa kana sokisi yakamonyororwa chete, garai pasi, musambokanda kumeso, uye muve nomukuru pedyo. Zvidimbu zvidiki zvinogona kupinza munhu mukufema.
flags: Haisi yevana vari pasi pe 3 makore: zvidimbu zvidiki
safety: Sarudzai bhegi rine chivharo chakabatirwa, kana mumonyorore sokisi yakachena. Ongororai kutanga kuona kana pane mabowo kana mataira asina kusimba, kuti kuzadza kusabuda.
Nyemba, mupunga nezvimwe zvizadzo zvidiki zvinogona kupinza munhu mukufema. Zvichengetei kure nevana vadiki nomunhu wese anoisa zvinhu mumuromo.
Garai pedyo kwazvo, muchitarisa zvakanaka kana pane chinhu chingaiswa mumuromo.
Garai pasi. Kandai nyoro uye pasi-pasi kuchinangwa chiri patafura, musambokanda kumeso.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Pepa rakadhindwa: chinangwa chine mhete nhatu dzinonzi Pedyo, Pakati na Kure, kubva kunze kusvika mukati, uye tafura yekuverenga ine kholamu yomunhu wega wega nomutsara wemabhokisi asina chinhu chimwe nechimwe mhete.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Isai pepa zvakatsetseka pakati penyu. Kukanda kunopinda mumhete, isai chiratidzo pabhokisi rimwe mukholamu yenyu, pamutsara wemhete iyoyo.

Nyorai meseji pamwe chete, kana kuti mumwe anonyora zvinotaurwa nemumwe.
Mumwe nomumwe anogona kumira nguva ipi neipi. Hapana kadhi rakakodzera zvakanyanya.

Munhu mumwe nemumwe anotora peji rimwe kana mapeji akawanda ayo oapenda.
Mavara nemaitiro haafanirwe kuenderana. Peji rimwe nerimwe rinhengo yepikicha imwe chete.
Isai mapeji pasi maererano nemazita awo, wobva mabatanidza nebhandi kumashure.
Isai idziva panzvimbo yose ivanhu vanogona kuona.

pictureBingo.start: Tsvodai "Mufananidzo unotevera" kuti mudane mufananidzo wekutanga.

calmBreathing.guidance: Fema mukati pamusoro pedenderedzwa rinenge richikura, uye bvisa mhepo pariri kudzika. Rinomira ega mushure memafemo matanhatu.
calmBreathing.started: Tangwa. Fema mukati pamene denderedzwa rinenge richikura.
calmBreathing.finished: Ndiwo mafemo matanhatu akanyorova. Tanga zvakare kana muchida.

storyChain.guidance: Tendeukai: mutsara mumwe nemumwe, wedzerai mufananidzo unotevera.
storyChain.passNote: Taurai mutsara wenyu nekunzwika. Hapana chinonyorwa kana kuchengetwa. Munhu wese anogona kupfuura.
storyChain.full: Ketani ine mifananidzo yose masere. Rondedzerai nyaya yose, kana tangai ketani itsva.

pictures.pine-cone-bird-feeder: Muchero wepaini wekudyisira shiri wakarembedzwa patavi

cards.prompt: Mungasarudza keke ipi kana muri kupemberera?
Ndiudzei nezvepai kana chikafu chitsva chemichero chamunofarira.
Munofarira tii kana kofi yenyu sei?
Chii chinoita kuti mangwanani anake zvakanyanya?
Makambonyatsotora michero zvakananga kubva pamuti here?
Inotapira kana inovava: ipi yamunofarira zvakanyanya?
Zuva rakanaka rizere nezuva rinoita sei kwamuri?
Katsi kana imbwa, kana zvose hazviite? Munofarira chii pamusoro pavo?
Shiri dzipi dzamunoona kana kuzwa kunze?
Makambofamba kuseka hove here, kana makambochengeta hove mumudziyo?
Mungada here kupedza zuva mugungwa kana mumakomo?
Kana mungakwanisa kubhururuka pamusoro penzvimbo ipi chete, ingava ipi?
Ndihobi ipi yamungagara muchiita maawa akawanda?
Chii chamakanga muchiziviwa nacho kugadzira kana kugadzirisa?
Mungapa zano ripi kumudiki anotanga basa?
Mimhanzi ipi inokuita kuti mugwedezere tsoka?
Chii chinoita kuti pati ive yakanaka zvakanyanya?
Ndefirimu ipi kana shoo yepaTV yamunoda kuona zvakare?
Zviratidzo zvekutanga zvegutsa zvinoonekwa sei kwamuri?
Chando, mvura, kana zuva: ipi yamunofarira?
